fire: She wrote her thesis in ethnology on the wedding customs of mountain villages.
He moved to Cairo to finish a doctorate in Egyptology at the university.
The lab studies psycholinguistics, especially how children learn new verbs.
Our department offers courses in sociolinguistics and the history of English.
She trained in paleontology and spent ten summers digging in Montana.
The seminar covered phenomenology, Husserl and the problem of perception.
Her fieldwork in ethnography took her to fishing towns along the coast.
He taught epistemology and logic at a small college in Ohio.

The seminar covered Husserl's life, his letters and his famous students.
Her ethnic background took her family to fishing towns along the coast.
